title: Roho yiyeguriye umuriro wera
intro: Mbere yawe hari inkuru y'ubutwari budasanzwe, aho umuntu umwe yatinyutse kurwanya imyizerere ikomeye cyane mu muco wose. Kurikira ibi bintu byo mu bihe byashize, uzavumbura ubuzima bwarangwaga no kwizera kudacogora, kubaho mu buryo bw'igitangaza, no gushyiraho urufatiro rwagize uruhare mu rugendo rw'umwuka rw'abantu babarirwa muri za miriyari. Reba neza buri kintu cyose - umuriro mutagatifu uracyacyibuka.
clues: Navukiye mu muryango wubahaga ibintu byo mu kirere n'ibishushanyo bisengwa, nyamara hari ikintu cyo muri njye cyanze ibyo basengaga.
Nahagaze ndwanya umutegetsi ukomeye cyane w’igihugu cyanjye, mvunagura ibigirwamana abantu banjye basengaga, kandi mvuga ko Umuremyi w’ijuru ari we wenyine ukwiye kwiheberwa.
Hategetswe umuriro ugurumana mu izina ryanjye, ariko natangaje ko Uwo nakoreraga wenyine ari we uzankiza — kandi umuriro wategetswe gukonja no kuba mu mutekano.
Nasize ibintu byose nari nzi ku itegeko ry'Imana, ngenda mu bibaya byumye hamwe n'umuryango wanjye, niringiraga ibyo ntari kubona.
Mpagaze iruhande rw'umuhungu wanjye w'imfura mu kibaya cy'ubutayu, twubaka urufatiro rw'inzu ndende, ahantu hera hagenewe abayoboka bose.
Nzwi ku izina rya Khalilullah — inshuti magara y'Imbabazi nyinshi — kandi izina ryanjye ryaje guhurirana iteka n'ukwemera kwitanga no kuganduka.

Yahawe ububasha bwo gutegeka umuyaga n'imbaraga zitagaragara
Yabaye umuvuzi wahawe umugisha wo gukira mu buryo bw'igitangaza
Hujwe imiryango cumi n'ibiri yatatanye mu isezerano rimwe
outcome.answer: Yamenyekanye nka Khalilullah, inshuti magara ya Allah

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
